args.subject: Warm Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! We're so pleased to have you joining our team next week in the marketing department.

I wanted to reach out with a warm welcome before you get started. The team is excited to have you on board, and I know there's a lot to get up to speed on. Please don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything I can help you with as you settle in — whether it's questions about our processes, getting set up with the tools you need, or simply finding your way around.

Looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
